notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]TRICK OR TREAT HALLOWEEN EVENT [/h1]
[i](Available now till November)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/552e3560e86dca87701abc6188f2eb85bac6069c.png[/img]

Put on your Halloween Mask and go Trick-or-Treating in the world of Horror Legends! Each Cast member has a special unlockable Halloween Mask, [i]unlock them all![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/5cbda02ecfc5311050988ca16a5014e0c633b191.png[/img]

Trick-or-Treat candy bowls have returned, interacting with the bowl will give you a 70% chance of getting a piece of Halloween candy or a 30% chance of getting tricked with a Zombie Cast member! [i] Be careful these zombies might be ravenous! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/bf0c78e69ca5553e507dec33645f6ca109984671.png[/img]

When you die in Cast Pregame you will respawn as a Gourd. 
Jack-O-Lanterns decorations have been placed on all the maps. 
Cabin got a spooky makeover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/50b20348e40627df010342f39b80015ddf7fcff3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/5c447ecc44e1075cb801896d7e4181e26db63633.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c408f3d582a89cb31e69a43c89625a7b154c25c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/b6a142a0bd03778a10501dca9ace5d2bd30f3b5c.png[/img]

[h1]Music[/h1]
The Horror Legends Album has been released on all streaming platforms and, to reflect this, all the music in the game has been remastered.

Spotify Link: https://open.spotify.com/artist/4FGgi1xCWzrXUNdSyUnqSv?si=5gox8EulQx-TeSzLXi_OJg

Apple ITunes Music: https://music.apple.com/us/album/_/1638179271?ign-itscg=30200&ign-itsct=lt_m

Amazon Music: https://music.amazon.com/artists/B09VNT98T3/spectral-fields

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_l7vkbz3y8VggtGsIJYNJfROA6CKInMUJI

Youtube Music: https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_l7vkbz3y8VggtGsIJYNJfROA6CKInMUJI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/9839f59a747a4f486ab9a359b04229ba4f58ab15.png[/img]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[h2]OBJECTIVES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased Matriarch Fail Timer Length from 480 seconds to 540 seconds
[/list]

[h2]PUNKIE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the time it takes to Destroy Punkie’s Jack-O-Lanterns from 30 seconds to 23 seconds
[*] Increased Fear gained by standing near a Jack-O-Lantern from 10 fear per second to 15 fear per second.
[*] Increased Fear Radius from 2 to 3 meters. 
[*] Increased Tracking Gourd Cooldown from 10 seconds to 24 seconds
[*] Destroying a Jack-O-Lantern will set you to max fear.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]New Map
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/eef369e43afc0cecf2179ed034d18b8e07bd3430.png[/img]

Focusing more on a linier design, Dream Realm offers a completely unique experience to Horror Legends!

Travel from one dream world to the next by opening mirror portals. Each world has its own unique character and playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/4ccf8e6553817be58386ac5a520c3d6458bf497b.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/36984218a7b2a66104aff4e86980755df7e59700.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/db99b49160170bcffdfccc3e5663938c819dee9a.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c206b404322b5c6c6519650f475e4c78cdd30659.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/d0ff6ddd7087ed6a226a19e9b25e23056ca939ba.png[/img]

Squish all the Spiders and unlock the Exterminator Achievement for Dream Realm!

[h3]Nightmare Punkie[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058160/Horror_Legends__Nightmare_Punkie_Skins/?curator_clanid=33852864

"When Ryan enters the Dream Realm she unknowingly unlocks a traumatic memory from her past manifesting itself within the Dream Realm. What once was buried deep in her subconscious, now stalks her to finish what he started all those years ago.”

Includes 6 skins for the Legend, Human Punke.

[list]
[*] Nightmare Punkie
[*] Bedsore
[*] Soul-eater
[*] The Damned

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/deb85fcad2bf8bc47d2572bda788d5dd5cab6609.png[/img]

Candy and Beer will no longer leave your inventory when downed and can now be used while in downstate.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.1
notes.content:
[h2]Pregame [/h2]
[list]
[*] Players that join your server will now see a prompt telling them they are wait for the host to start the game
[/list]


[h2]Escape portal[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased Escape time from 130 to 160
[*] Increased Legend interrupting Nana Channeling Except spell time from 30 seconds to 45
[*] Decreased Nana Channeling Respawn Time from 20 to 15 seconds
[*] Increased Teleport time from 2 to 5 seconds.
[*] Added effect when escape portal is used.
[/list]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed Holiday Event props on all maps. 
[*] Minor prop tweaks
[/list].

[b]Salvage Yard[/b]
[b]Removed map exploits in crane station.[/b]

[b]Cabin[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Lighting to from a Dusk setting to a Thick Foggy Overcast. 
[*] Minor navmesh fixes.
[/list]

[h2]CHARACTERS[/h2]

[h3]Cast[/h3]
[b]Movement[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased Walk speed from 3.8 to 3.7
[*] Decreased Critical Walk speed from 3.5 to 2.9
[*] Critical Run Speed now matches healthy run speed but increased their time to max speed from 2 seconds to 3 seconds.
[/list]
[i](NOTE: these changes will keep Cast old jump height but with a higher gravity so you’ll remain at the highest point for your jump for less time. Which will force Cast players to better time their jumps when avoiding hits from the legend.)[/i]

[list]
[*] Increased Gravity on cast jump from 1.1 to 1.6 
[*] Increased Jump Height from 8.5 to 9.5
[*] Increased Crouch Jump Height from 8.1 to 9.5
[/list]

[b]Items[/b]
[list]
[*] All Guns now have one Full clip of ammo loaded into the gun and one extra clip.
[*] Ammo will no longer spawn on the map.
[*] Harbinger drops 2 extra clips off ammo if he is killed by the Legend.
[*] Reduced Medicine Bottle from 8 to 5 charges. 
[/list]

[b]Bat [/b]
[list]
[*] Half extends increased from .55 to 1
[/list]

[b]Switchblade[/b]
[list]
[*] Reach increased from 1.1 to 1.3
[/list]

[b]Kitchen Knife [/b]
[list]
[*] Charge Reach increased from 1.6 to 1.8
[/list]

[b]Machete[/b]
[list]
[*] Stab reach increased from 1.3 to 1.5
[*] Charge Reach increased from 1.6 to 1.8
[*] Stab and charge melee half extends increased to 1 from .85
[/list]

[h3]LEGENDS[/h3]

[b]Corey [/b]
[i]New ability “Enraged”[/i]
Corey will build up energy every time she is killed. Once the bar is full Corey can call upon her AI Decoy’s to attack the closest cast member. AI Coreys are revealed in RED to the Corey player to maximize their strategic potential.

[list]
[*] Increased AI Corey’s from 2 to 4
[*] Increased Decoy Corey's from 15 to 20
[/list]

Health
[list]
[*] Increased regeneration speed from 2 to 3
[*] Decreased Max HP from 70 to 60
[/list]

Movement
[list]
[*] Turn on Air Control
[*] Decreased Travel Mode Start cooldown from 30 seconds to 16 seconds.
[*] Sprint Speed increased from 5.6 to 6
[*] Increased Travel Mode time from 10 to 12 seconds.
[*] Decreased Time to max sprint speed from 6 seconds to 5 seconds
[*] Jump height increased from 9 to 11.1
[/list]

Knife Melee
[list]
[*] Primary Attack: Increased Melee Damage from 7 to 8
[*] Secondary Attack: Decreased charge time from 0.633 to .4
[*] Secondary Attack: Increased Maximum charge damage from 23 to 25
[/list]

Knife Throw
[list]
[*] Increased Damage from 30 to 35 
[*] Increased Fear Damage from 35 for 3 seconds to 100 for 1 second (Max Fear on impact)

[*] Reduced Knockback Drag from 10 to 2

Movement

[/list]

Decoys
[list]
[*] Increased Idle time from 5-10 seconds to 30 seconds
[*] Decreased Move time from 25-30 seconds to 10 seconds
[*] Edith AI Damage from 4 to 1
[*] Edith AI move speed reduced from 2.5 to 2.2
[/list]

Hair-Nails 
[list]
[*] Primary  Attack damage reduced from 30 to 20

[*] Sprint Jump Stamina cost increased from 15 to 20

[/list]

[b]Psych Phil[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced end sprint speed from 5.5 to 5.3
[/list]

[b]Radu[/b]
[list]
[*] Walk Speed Increased from 3 > 3.5 over 3 seconds to 3.9
[*] Decreased Sprint Jump Stamina Cost from 50 to 40

[/list]

Sword
[list]
[*] Primary Attack: Increased Damage from 15 to 20
[*] Primary Attack: Added Life steal of 15 per hit

[*] Secondary Attack: Added a minimum charge time of 0.25

[*]

Summon Subspecies

[*] Removed player collision.

Seize
[list]
[*] Removed Health Damage

[*] Can Disarm if hit

[b]Werewolf[/b]
Movement
[list]
[*] Walk Speed Increased from 3 to 3.8
[*] Leaving Travel Mode cooldown decreased from 30 to 15

[*] Decreased Stamina Pause Rate on from 5 to 1

[*] Increased Damage of Claws from 5 to 10

[*] 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where if you are chosen to be the Legend and you leave while the map loads then it will lock the game up for everyone else. 
[*] Fixed an issue where bots would not interrupt finishers.
[*] Fixed an issue where bots would spawn in the wrong spawn point if Edith was the Legend.
[*] Fixed an issue  where the Matriarch would kill the Legend if they were finishing off a Marked cast member right when she is about to down them.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Matriarch would not down bots.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Matriarch would down the legend if there were no cast player and only bot cast.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI will try to destroy Warehouse door.
[*] Removed Medicine Bottle cooldown exploits. 
[*] Dramatically increased bootup time for lower end machines. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b]CAST BOT SUPPORT[/b]
You can now turn Cast bots on in the Host menu. They work in all game modes - Cast Pregame - Legend Pregame - and Main Game.

[i]Note: Turn on Cast Bots in Legend Pregame if you want to team up with a friend and hunt down some Cast Bots before you play the main game![/i]

[b]Legends now have objective Prompts.[/b]

[b]NPC Cops are revealed to Security Shawn and Sheriff Russell.[/b]

[b]AI Gourd’s ignore downed players[/b]

[h3]New Skins[/h3]
Punkie - Echo unlocked with 100,000 fate
Punkie - Slave unlocked at level 100

[h3]Christmas Presents![/h3]
From Corey: 50% chance at getting either a Support Item or a Gourd
From Santa Phil: 70% at spawning a  Zombie 30% Chance at getting a Medicine Bottle!
From Punkie: 90% at spawning a Zombie, 10% Chance at getting a Gun!

[i]Note: You can find the presents under the Christmas Trees on each map![/i]

[h3]Doors[/h3]
Cast can no longer damage doors.
Reduced Woodend Door Hit Points from 250 to 100.
Reduced Metal Door Hit Points from 1000 to 500.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[h3]Ryan[/h3]
[b](New Ability) Spell Destruction - Cost Fate 10000[/b]
Ryan can shoot a powerful fireball doing damage over time for 2 seconds. 

[h3]Punkie[/h3]
[b]Broken Scythe[/b]
Removed Health and Stamina Damage from Alternate Attack.

Nana's teachings are starting to pay off. Ryan can conjure a ball of light energy that removes fear and heals 1 health every second for all Cast Members that are within its radius.

notes.content:
[h2]Werewolf[/h2]

[*] Adjusted the leap stamina cost so it allows for 4 leaps if you have a full stamina bar.

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from the October Games Studio! [/h1]

Horror Legends summer update is now live! Listed below are the full patch notes you can expect in the new version of the game!

[h2][b]OBJECTIVE SYSTEM[/b][/h2]
The objective system has been completely redesigned.
[*] Objective system that has 3 phases to complete, designed to keep cast more engaged during game play.
[*] Objective Prompts designed to keep you informed on what to do next

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c76217a5ad73bff5f07b4aaeb859133abb7dde91.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Nana the Witch[/b] has been added to the game and functions alongside the new objective system.
[*] Use witchcraft to dismantle demonic effigies preventing your escape!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/720716fa43442d4b218d60be8fab47927c35b562.gif[/img]

[*] [b]The Matriarch[/b] a malevolent and powerful witch has been added to the game and will attack the Cast 1 by 1 if the objectives have not been completed after a certain amount of time.
[*] In phase 3 you can stand in Nana’s radius to speed up the escape portal spawn time. If they legend collides with Nana's player model it will freeze the escape timer and reveal all cast.
[*] The escape zone has now been turned into a teleport zone that will teleport you into Nana’s hideout.
[*] Inside Nana’s hideout there is a teleport zone that will take you back into the map if you wish to go back and try to save someone.

[h2][b]DOWNED STATE[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c0d828ad34074f3d57bcda6a73206ead1be54261.gif[/img]

[*] Another massive update to the game where all Cast and even some Legends will enter a downed state when they run out of Health. 
[*] A down player will auto recover if they enter downed state after and extended period of time.
[*] Allies can expedite the recovery of a downed player by healing them when they hold the "Use" button.

[b]Legends will be able to perform Finishers on downed players complete with a gruesomely animated cutscene![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/080c748d5e5e692e8522f69e1c7053b77bc94138.gif[/img]

[*] Once they have entered the vulnerable state Legend can hold the use button and activate the Finisher.
[*] A player entering the downed state for the first time will have a short duration of time where they are protected from the Legend's Finisher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/e7f33fe56435513067480b45fc20ad8889a3bf75.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] A Legend's Finisher can be interrupted if they take any damage while doing the finisher before the killing blow.  
[/list]

[b][h2]CONTROLS[/h2][/b]
[*] The game now has Controller support!
[*] All the controls in the game are FULLY customizable!
[*] The default drop Item key bind is now set to “G”

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c90eddb23aa2a96942af645b83ccacb0e27ad0a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/7b31f6a4132b9dd3789addd0d294d7b73ed9bb6a.png[/img][/url]



[h2][b]LEGENDS[/b][/h2]
[*]All legend’s have had their Night Vision reduced. 
[*] All travel modes now have a cooldown when you start the match.
[*] Some Legend Weapons now have a max charge time so you can't hold your charge forever! 

[h3]Punkie (Human)[/h3]
[*] added a downed state
[*] Will now be invulnerable for a short period of time after leaving downed state
[*] added a kill mechanic
[*] added a Faze that will teleport him away from cast players
[*] added a travel mode

[h3]
Punkie[/h3]
[*]Remastered original Punkies Skins.
[*]Added 6 new Punkie Skins!
[*]increased movement speed from 4.21 to 4.31
[*]Increased Poison splinter damage and now does fear damage instead of static reveal. 

[h3]Edith[/h3]
[*] Added a Alternate ability (“Pounce”) That can be unlocked for 5000 Fate points and selected in the character select screen, 
[*] Pounce ability - Edith will lunge forward and attack with a devastating attack after a delay. The attack does 125 damage if you land it having the ability to down a cast member in 1 hit with the trade off that it's very hard to land. 
[*] Flurry Default main attack has been adjusted - Edith's flurry attack no longer has a charge. Both left and right click attacks have zero cooldown. With the left click doing 4 points less damage but doing 8 points of stamina damage. 
[*]Reduced Edith's Teleport stamina cost from 20 to 15
[*]Removed Stamina drain from AI Edith
[*] Added 3 holy water spawns in Edith’s game mode for a total of 10 up from 7 on all maps.

[h3]Werewolf [/h3]
[*] Added a Alternate ability (“Bloody Roar”) That can be unlocked for 5000 Fate points and selected in the character select screen, 

[h3]Killer Keith[/h3]
[*] Increased Travel Mode timer to 60 seconds from 30 seconds.

[h3]Corey[/h3]
[*]Knife charges are now unlimited but with a cool down.
[*]Adjusted her health to 70 hp
[*]Added a travel mode

[h3]Psycho Phil [/h3]
[*] Max Run speed has been increased from 4.1 to 4.31
[*] Crossbow Damage has be reduced to 10 from 25
[*] Crossbow Stamina damage has been reduced from 20 to 10
[*] now does 50 fear damage instead of static reveal.


[h2][b]CAST[/b][/h2]
[*] You can now perform a finishing kill on the Werewolf if you have the Silver Sword
[*] All cast have had their Sprint and walk speed increased Slightly

[b][h2]Maps[/h2][/b]
[*]Cut scenes have been added to the game before you begin a match and after one is over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/711b2037d2e5be4a8fbf735a01f5f154c2e89df3.gif[/img]

[h3]Salvage Yard[/h3]
[*]Improved Design
[*]Improved Key Spawns
[*]Improved Item Spawns	
[*]Adding more environmental storytelling

[h3]Cabin[/h3]
[*] Complete redesign of the map
[*] Added a Boat House
[*]Added a Cave
[*]Updated Vegetation
[*]Redesigned the terrain
[*] Improved Crouch Zones

[h3]Farm House[/h3]
[*] Improved Crouch zones

[i]Dream Realm and Hedge maze have been remove and are currently being reworked for our new objective system. They will return! 
[/i]
[h2][b]UI, HUD & Menus[/b][/h2]
[*]The UI HUD in game has been revised and improved. 
[*]All characters in the game have unique Illustrated Portraits Icons that reflect their Fear and Health state.  
[*]Legends can now see portraits of all cast players but their portraits will be hidden until that cast has been revealed. 
[*]Added cooldown and charge graphic in the ability hud to let the player know how long they can charge their weapon for and how long the cooldown will be until they can use it again.
[*] If the player is gaining health their health bar will flash green.
[*] If the player is gaining stamina their stamina bar will flash green. 
[*] The End Game and Tab screens have been reworked
[*]Objective prompts have been added to help new player during each phase of the match.
[*] Players now have their names and health bars shown above their head if you are within a certain radius of them.
[*]Added interaction Icons to give more feedback when the player can interact with something.
[*] Added a Dark red background to the health bar of the downed player to show the threshold in which that player's health needs to be at to be revived. 
[*] The health bar has been updated from just a number to now showing a number with a bar.
[*] The Ui at the top shows a representation of which phase the match is in and the number of currently active effigies
[*] The game's menus have been made simpler and more user friendly.

[h2][b]GENERAL[/b][/h2]
[*] Added a feature where if you use certain abilities it will automatically revert back to your default attack ability.
[*]Added a Crouch Jump animation.

[h2][b]NPC’s[/b][/h2]
[*] The Cops and Harbinger NPC's will be able to revive downed players!
[*] NPCS’s are now affected by hazard zones.
[*] NPC’s now have a hit reaction animation when taking damage
[*] NPC’s now have a jump animation.
[*] NPC’s have a blood effects when hit.

[h2][b]Doors[/b][/h2]
[*] Improved Door physics, you can now close a door on a legends face and it wont get stuck.

[h2][b]Music and Sound[/b][/h2]
[*] New sound effects have been added and many of the game's sound effects have been improved. 
[*] Psycho Phil, Matriarch, and Werewolf Music Themes have been added to the game
[*] Psycho Phil and Werewolf Fear music themes have been added to the game

[h2][b]Concept Art[/b][/h2]
[*]Added 18 extra concept art that can be unlocked with fate. 



BUG FIXES
[*]Fixed a Bug where the cat would reveal from very far away.
[*] Fixed a bug that a spectator bug that would lock UI elements to screen when the game would end
[*]Fixed a Bug where Edith wouldn't teleport always once her stamina was at zero if she was in the air.
[*] Fixed a bug that wouldn’t let you swap with Ai Edith's if you were outside 100 meters. 
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause Edith players and her AI to be unkillable
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause AI ravers to get stuck in their sliding or dancing animation state
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause some elements in the game to teleport to different locations when the host left the server
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the harbinger to damage cast players
[*]Fixed a bug in the esc menu in game where the resume button would stop working
[*]Fixed a bug that where cops bullets were doing no damage
[*]Fixed a bug where some AI would ignore doors
[*] Fixed a bug with AI Corey's attack box turning into a collider when you would kill her. 

[/list]

This has been one of the biggest updates for Horror Legends. We are excited for you to play the new release and would love to hear your feedback! Connect with us and our community on our discord! [url=https://discord.gg/aqAMKHP]https://discord.gg/aqAMKHP[/url]

See you in game! 
October Games Team.

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings from the October Games Studio! [/h1]

Horror Legends summer update is now live! Listed below are the full patch notes you can expect in the new version of the game!

[h2][b]OBJECTIVE SYSTEM[/b][/h2]
The objective system has been completely redesigned.
[*] Objective system that has 3 phases to complete, designed to keep cast more engaged during game play.
[*] Objective Prompts designed to keep you informed on what to do next

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c76217a5ad73bff5f07b4aaeb859133abb7dde91.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Nana the Witch[/b] has been added to the game and functions alongside the new objective system.
[*] Use witchcraft to dismantle demonic effigies preventing your escape!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/720716fa43442d4b218d60be8fab47927c35b562.gif[/img]

[*] [b]The Matriarch[/b] a malevolent and powerful witch has been added to the game and will attack the Cast 1 by 1 if the objectives have not been completed after a certain amount of time.
[*] In phase 3 you can stand in Nana’s radius to speed up the escape portal spawn time. If they legend collides with Nana's player model it will freeze the escape timer and reveal all cast.
[*] The escape zone has now been turned into a teleport zone that will teleport you into Nana’s hideout.
[*] Inside Nana’s hideout there is a teleport zone that will take you back into the map if you wish to go back and try to save someone.

[h2][b]DOWNED STATE[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c0d828ad34074f3d57bcda6a73206ead1be54261.gif[/img]

[*] Another massive update to the game where all Cast and even some Legends will enter a downed state when they run out of Health. 
[*] A down player will auto recover if they enter downed state after and extended period of time.
[*] Allies can expedite the recovery of a downed player by healing them when they hold the "Use" button.

[b]Legends will be able to perform Finishers on downed players complete with a gruesomely animated cutscene![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/080c748d5e5e692e8522f69e1c7053b77bc94138.gif[/img]

[*] Once they have entered the vulnerable state Legend can hold the use button and activate the Finisher.
[*] A player entering the downed state for the first time will have a short duration of time where they are protected from the Legend's Finisher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/e7f33fe56435513067480b45fc20ad8889a3bf75.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] A Legend's Finisher can be interrupted if they take any damage while doing the finisher before the killing blow.  
[/list]

[b][h2]CONTROLS[/h2][/b]
[*] The game now has Controller support!
[*] All the controls in the game are FULLY customizable!
[*] The default drop Item key bind is now set to “G”

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c90eddb23aa2a96942af645b83ccacb0e27ad0a7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/7b31f6a4132b9dd3789addd0d294d7b73ed9bb6a.png[/img][/url]



[h2][b]LEGENDS[/b][/h2]
[*]All legend’s have had their Night Vision reduced. 
[*] All travel modes now have a cooldown when you start the match.
[*] Some Legend Weapons now have a max charge time so you can't hold your charge forever! 

[h3]Punkie (Human)[/h3]
[*] added a downed state
[*] Will now be invulnerable for a short period of time after leaving downed state
[*] added a kill mechanic
[*] added a Faze that will teleport him away from cast players
[*] added a travel mode

[h3]
Punkie[/h3]
[*]Remastered original Punkies Skins.
[*]Added 6 new Punkie Skins!
[*]increased movement speed from 4.21 to 4.31
[*]Increased Poison splinter damage and now does fear damage instead of static reveal. 

[h3]Edith[/h3]
[*] Added a Alternate ability (“Pounce”) That can be unlocked for 5000 Fate points and selected in the character select screen, 
[*] Pounce ability - Edith will lunge forward and attack with a devastating attack after a delay. The attack does 125 damage if you land it having the ability to down a cast member in 1 hit with the trade off that it's very hard to land. 
[*] Flurry Default main attack has been adjusted - Edith's flurry attack no longer has a charge. Both left and right click attacks have zero cooldown. With the left click doing 4 points less damage but doing 8 points of stamina damage.

[*]Removed Stamina drain from AI Edith
[*] Added 3 holy water spawns in Edith’s game mode for a total of 10 up from 7 on all maps.

[h3]Werewolf [/h3]
[*] Added a Alternate ability (“Bloody Roar”) That can be unlocked for 5000 Fate points and selected in the character select screen, 

[h3]Killer Keith[/h3]
[*] Increased Travel Mode timer to 60 seconds from 30 seconds.

[h3]Corey[/h3]
[*]Knife charges are now unlimited but with a cool down.
[*]Adjusted her health to 70 hp
[*]Added a travel mode

[*] Max Run speed has been increased from 4.1 to 4.31
[*] Crossbow Damage has be reduced to 10 from 25
[*] Crossbow Stamina damage has been reduced from 20 to 10
[*] now does 50 fear damage instead of static reveal.


[h2][b]CAST[/b][/h2]
[*] You can now perform a finishing kill on the Werewolf if you have the Silver Sword

[b][h2]Maps[/h2][/b]
[*]Cut scenes have been added to the game before you begin a match and after one is over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/711b2037d2e5be4a8fbf735a01f5f154c2e89df3.gif[/img]

[h3]Salvage Yard[/h3]
[*]Improved Design

[/i]

[*]Added 18 extra concept art that can be unlocked with fate.

This has been one of the biggest updates for Horror Legends. We are excited for you to play the new release and would love to hear your feedback! Connect with us and our community on our discord! [url=https://discord.gg/aqAMKHP]https://discord.gg/aqAMKHP[/url]

October Games Team.

[h1]New Legend [/h1]

[h2]Edith - The Night Terror[/h2]

[b]Hair Nails[/b] - LMB is a fast Melee Attack that you can use to shed through your prey. RMB is a chargeable Melee Attack that does minor stun at its lowest charge and Massive damage at its maximum charge. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/db133c3cb814168041aa6bf7b5ebad7b882b5ba1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/17a31455fcc224992f928f38dd2e2e06e650116e.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/ce7d8e8076721492f1bbc5090f87e4d01af73e9e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/f8ebcb91fd6a87cbb6c4336e833393cf6dc682bc.png[/img][/url]
[b]Teleport[/b] - Randomly Teleport near a living Cast Member, requires 20 stamain to use.

[b]Rage [/b]- Is Edith’s version of stamina that she slowly builds up over time. You can build up additional Rage if you are near living Cast Members which will stack depending on how many Cast Members are nearby. 

[b]Edith Passive Radius[/b] - If a Cast Member is inside the radius Edith will drain their stamina and her stamina will increase faster. 

[b]Edith AI [/b]- Are Identical to Edith, they have the same radius as the Edith player, draining cast stamina, and increasing Edith's stamina regen while they are inside. The Edith player can swap places with these AI and they will light up when cast are nearby. 

[b]Travel Mode[/b] - (Warp) Hold down (T) to become invisible and fast travel for a short amount of time. Travel mode has a cooldown.

[*] New Library added to the stair room

[/list]

[list]
[*] General Design and layout improvements

[*] Light sources like Lanterns, Glowsticks, and FirePits, will reduce your Fear.

notes.title: Horror Legends: Version 0.2.8 Preview
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Over here at October Games Drake and I have been hard at work developing a new update for Horror Legends. The update will feature some big changes that will drastically change and improve how the game is played. We are very excited and wanted to communicate with you on some of the changes we have been working on.

[h2]Doors[/h2]
[b]Doors will now open both ways and will always open away from the way you are facing.[/b]
[i]We received a lot of feedback from players that they did not enjoy doors opening only 1 way and we agreed that even though it’s less realistic, it provides much better gameplay.[/i]

[b]If you crouch and open a door it will open silently[/b]
[i]we felt like this was something important to HL as there was never a way to open doors silently but now all of those players looking for more stealthy gameplay will have fun with this one ;)[/i]

[b]Some Doors will have deadbolt locks on them that you will be able to lock and unlock.[/b]
[i]we always had the intention of adding this, without it cast don’t have many options when getting chased and now they will have opportunities to quickly close and lock a door on a legend.[/i]

[b]Some Doors will require a key or a special tool to unlock.[/b]
[i]We felt this was essential to horror legends going forward, We wanted to have the ability to lock certain powerful weapons and items behind these doors like the silver sword to kill the werewolf as one example. It also allows us to create sections of a map, buildings, or rooms that can only be accessed  by finding a key which creates a mini objective to progress to these areas.[/i]

[h2]Keys and Tools[/h2]
[b]Keys can now be found on the map to unlock specific doors. 
Some Doors might require a special tool like bolt cutters to open for example.
[/b]

[h2]Knockback Mechanic[/h2]
[b]Certain attacks and weapons can now knock back a player pushing them in the direction the attacking player is facing.[/b]
[i]This Mechanic is so cool, using the bat to knock back Killer Kieth just feels so good, it gives certain attacks so much more utility and it's just one more way a player can save themselves in a chase.[/i]

[b]Here are some of the Items and attacks that have a knockback[/b]
[list]
[*] Shove
[*] Bat
[*] Pitchfork
[*] Shotgun
[*] Revolver
[/list]

[h2]Movement Speed Damage [/h2]
[b]We now have the ability to create weapons, attacks, and aoe abilities / zones that will slow your movement speed.[/b] [i]At this time we have yet to implement this in any specific way but some ways we have talked about implementing it are on Killer Kieth’s Attacks and his gas cloud. [/i]

[h2]Jumping[/h2]
[b]When you are out of stamina you will still be able to jump.[/b]
[i]This change was a lot more complicated than it seems, jumping will still deplete your stamina but you’ll be able to jump when you have no stamina. We knew it was frustrating not being able to jump out of the lava in the dream realm if you fell in with no stamina. This change should help players platform and run from the legend by jumping up hay bails and into a window if you are out of stamina.[/i]

[b]Jumping now has a very very short cooldown to prevent bunny hopping.[/b]
Bunning hopping was never intended for our game as it looks and feels unrealistic, the cooldown is very short and shouldn't really be noticeable also providing a more realism as you can’t really jump consecutively very fast in real life. We have the ability to change what this cooldown will be, our plan is to find a sweet spot that prevents bunning hoping while still feeling fluid and nice.

[h2]Stamina[/h2]
We are reworking the Stamina system, Giving players a lot more stamina but having the stamina regeneration rate be a lot slower. We are hoping that this will make players use their stamina more wisely and also incentivize them to walk and couch more as you will need to do this to regen your stamina. This also means that items that regen your stamina will be a lot more useful while attacks that deplete stamina will be a lot more effective. This will be a big change and we will keep a close eye on how this plays out. 

[h2]Stealth[/h2]
We are thinking about ways to shift horror legends to have more elements of stealth gameplay to it. Right now the balance is heavily focused on finding items and the objective as quickly as possible. We want to provide players another avenue to achieve these same tasks but from a stealthy perspective. We will be keeping an eye and talking about how we can do this going into the future so along with doors opening silently when crouched, we have reduced the audio of the walking and crouch footstep volumes for all characters. (mind you the discrepancy of volume between characters will still remain depending on their stealth stat value). 

[h2]Animations[/h2]
We are currently remastering all of the Cast’s third person animations. 

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[b]New Map Salvage Yard[/b] [i]The Birthplace of Killer Keith, littered with jun, filth, and an ominous fog that looms over the yard. You'll be unsure of what will be lurking around each corner. The map will be a perfect addition as it's layout and feel is like any other that is currently in game. [/i]

[b]Farmhouse[/b] has had a massive redesign to its vegetation, There were issues that the old vegetation was causing on performance and we are hoping that this map will be much more optimized now. The corn-maze has changed and there are updates to some of the buildings on the map to make the map more interesting and have more character. 

[b]Cabin[/b] has also had a big redesign in its vegetation, the same performance issues were plaguing the cabin. Also several points of interest have been added to the map to give it more character. 

[h2]New Playable Cast Member[/h2]
[b]You will now be able to play as the raver that is featured in the pregame mode.[/b]

[h2]Corey Sisley[/h2]
[b]New A[/b]I[b]
	We have added an AI companion to Corey’s kit; another Corey posing as one of her decoys. If a Cast Member is in range it will attack them revealing them to the Legend. [/b] [i]We have been keeping a close eye on Corey, her kit has taken a hit after we had to remove players turning into Corey’s when they die, this decoy change will help her tracking a lot and should add some spook, we have been looking at ways reintroduce dead players turning into Coreys [/i]

[h2]Character Controller update[/h2]
	[b]Players will no longer be able to stick to and climb steep walls. [/b]
[i]We never wanted players to be able to do this and it was just a by-product of the system we had. We have finally been able to update our programming to reflect this change.[/i]

[h2]Spectator Mode[/h2]
[b]Players will now be able to spectate games; by pressing escape and clicking the spectate option in the menu screen or in the character select screen. [/b]
[i]This feature has been long overdue and we know many of you have been asking for it! [/i]

[h2]Items spawn system [/h2]
	[b]The Item spawn system has had a massive overhaul. Now each match there will be a much more random set of items you are given.[/b] T[i]he way our old system worked wasn’t reliable and limited us from what we could ultimately do. We will have the ability to create much more random and interesting spawn sets for each map making each match feel a bit more unique.[/i] 

Your feedback is so important to us and we want to thank all of you who have expressed your opinions. We encourage you to keep providing feedback. Any thoughts about this preview please share them on our discord. The projected timeline for these features is undetermined but hopefully in the month of May you can expect to see these updates. If you’re interested in testing some of the features sooner, we will be releasing a test build in the coming weeks. So stay tuned and we really appreciate everyone who helps us test the game! 


Nicholas Haye a.k.a Spectral Fields 
Game Designer / Music Composer

[h2]Corey Sisley[/h2]
Once a toy-maker herself, now haunts her very own failed line of Anny Nanny dolls as her own personal hell and she is going to take it out on the Cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/d2f97f6412e4f3d05584e78439da8dbfc6fe0de4.png[/img]

[b]Knife Attack[/b]
Straight forward and to the point. A wise man once said. "A true classic never goes out of style" 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c5e2c665d0ca4ae7259bb66e964c38e0be22be6a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/8988e7135c182f2b53721fca13e6abd56c66881e.png[/img][/url]

[b]Knife Throw[/b]
Great for softening them up before you charge in for the kill.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/37ada1eeb74c16c4d1eb70143de110e98f516a39.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/499a2e305d43a23f250b531dfc34e73eebf3dfee.png[/img][/url]

[b]Decoys.[/b]
Both Corey and Phil use Doll decoys on the map to track their prey. The decoys will light up when a Cast member is within 30 meters of one.  The Cast can destroy the decoys and receive a small Fate Reward but it will reveal them if they do. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/3bb4d7100e6c11db561c6b366132ce08cd675b75.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/d314308143d7d32d7e3bb8547195d239d8e4371f.png[/img][/url]

[b]Doll Mode[/b]
Corey can actually hide among-st her doll decoys using the Doll Mode ability. Press 3 then crouch to blend right it. Try not to move when the cast are nearby or else you'll give yourself away.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/8c04d94804f1b3752f0b637b6e5726259b829308.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/ca8fb256e0ca4debfebbdda142361a1ebb495fe3.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Map Overhauls[/h2]

[h3]Cabin[/h3]
This map is now 3 times larger and includes a new spawn location for the Cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/bce1642a7fd0c6a8d4ed40e08c2aea03575434a8.png[/img]

[h3]Hedgemaze[/h3]
We opened up the maze and added additional greenhouses and points of interest on the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c3e5c189e968fa6552459901a03d2ed8c1fc2838.jpg[/img]
  
[h3]DreamRealm[/h3]
The Platforming room as been replaced with a Lava pit and ruined walkways. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/6539b1ee1152ecc3026ffbd21c4ae31b4a82dc30.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Music[/h2]
Two brand new music tracks for Corey and Killer Keith created by the game composer Spectral Fields. 

[h2]Hint System. [/h2]
Gameplay hints will now show up in the chat box ever few minutes. Great for new players!

[h2]Fate UI [/h2]
You can now see your total Fate on the main menu and Fate Store screens. 

[h2]Bug Fixes and balance changes.[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed offline mode.
[*] Fixed Specter spawning bug for all Specter based Legends. 
[*] Damage Indicator now appears when you attack doors and windows. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Buffed Killer Keith's  dash jump distance.
[*] Buffed Killer Keith's Health Regeneration.
[*] Buffed Werewolf's pounce jump stamina cost. 
[*] Reduced Pistol's damage. 
[*] Reduced Silver Sword poison damage on Werewolf. 
[*] Reduced Human Punkie's Regeneration Charges.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/a140ac4fb7dea22c7b133c80b6723a122a1a7307.png[/img]

[h1]New Playable Legend - Werewolf[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/65f73890e71c43174eae815ad1de06f3930801f9.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/487eea1c8d7bc6da4a2561073de6d0675a49cbd7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c3b01463e21f48cee315027f4069fbd55a03980f.png[/img][/url]
A ferocious beast that uses its animal instincts to track and kill its prey and  then devour their flesh. Stalk using his stealthy crawl and pounce to close the distance. They will never see you coming.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/6947765721c825baf8df2373847cff1c30c72159.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/abd9fca6ca65f968429e832bb4af29afb56c5813.png[/img][/url]
[RMB] Viscous Claw attacks.
[LMB] Charge Bite attack that does more damage the longer you hold it.
[i]Both attack can replenish HP on any thing made of flesh.[/i]
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/e3b0b7fe6bcabc39944061e2cdf30807635ee5ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/4be762fd3e9be08b9a1ef6c45797227ab1c67048.png[/img][/url]
Press X to use the Werewolf's new form of Tracking; the [b]Smell [/b]ability!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/3ea9c384a8c48fddc35ba8f040c76a62d52d1d2b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/c05ce83632a0d150d6321300333013af17a2e0de.png[/img][/url]
Werewolf can howl and gain unlimited stamina for 30 seconds. 
Werewolf can leap from a crouched position 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/50b7c1fbec7de44998340831b7f45feb0f084fd7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/575d063001b96efb07dc5214d3d5d37d05536d96.png[/img][/url]
The Werewolf requires you to attack him with a [b]Silver Blade[/b] to prevent him from resurrecting were he die. Be careful if the Werewolf resurrects he will be invincible for 11 seconds!

[h1]New Playable Cast - Kimmy Green[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/3ad88d9ce5db7671075a75dd41903b8f563b2cb0.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/6033990d6c0787ca63c02d7c78b4a8e7b3747757.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/e1e974e48a186f44c2cd45610e7d7df0c9df70d9.png[/img][/url]
A nerdy college student with a love of chemistry.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/cab59e61674053756d965bc3d71dfe7da3a782df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/ddb9f3fc325e7f0a3ba932dbd395195015eb9995.png[/img][/url]
Special Item: [b]Stink-bomb [/b] If hit the Legend will be revealed for a long period of time. 

[h1]New Punkie VO[/h1]
[i]"Let the blood harvest begin!"[/i]

[h1]Progression update [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/523b03afd3445dc1c99bf908ef34c881c1c9f1e3.gif[/img]
[list][*] FP (Fate Points) is now earned alongside XP points.  FP is currency that you spend on unlockables in the Store. 	
[*] Fate Store - Where you spend your FP. 
[*] Skins for characters can now be unlocked with FP
[*] Items in Sub Categories are unlocked by spending FP
[*] Concept Art and Photos are unlocked by spending FP
[*] Comic pages are only unlockable by spending FP.
[*] [i]Update Character Select screen with Stats and Load-out from Skin screen.[/i][/list]

[h1]Legend PreGame [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/0519dcc1d7184fa8ab344433dff76ec1cc894682.jpg[/img]
[list][*]You can now play as a Legend in Pregame!
[*] Ravers are roaming looking to party and you’re the world’s biggest party pooper kill them all and earn FP.
[*] Find randomly spawned Boomboxes to gain bonus FP. Boomboxes attract Ravers and make them dance.  
[*] Kill enough Ravers and Cops will start to spawn and try to protect the Ravers. Kill them to earn FP.
[*] Fight other Legend Players as they join your pregame. Unbalanced, yes. Fun, hell yeah! Supports up to 10 players.
[*] Both Legend and Cast Pregame now require the [b]Host to press F1[/b] to start the game when the required number of players have joined. So if you want to stay in pregame you can![/list]

[h1]Adjust Escape timer based on Player count.[/h1]
[list][*] 1 Cast = 4mins
[*] 2 Cast = 5 Mins
[*] 3 Cast = 6 Mins
[*] 4 Cast = 8 Mins
[*] 5 Cast = 10mins
[*] 6 Cast = 12mins
[*] 7 Cast = 15mins
[*] 8 Cast = 18mins
[*] 9 Cast = 20mins[/list]

[h1]Secondary Objective - update[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Ectoplasm Orbs[/b] are now visible to everyone. Both Specters and Casts can collect these items which will reduce the Glyph escape timer.
[*] Legend can also collect the ghost item and it will freeze the Glyph timer, 
[*] Cast have to find next ghost item which will unfreeze the timer.[/list]

[h1]UI Overhaul [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33852864/a8fa2cac13407b098bc2bac6fd66fa6e44961176.png[/img]
[list][*] Fancy new Comic Background.
[*] Improved all menus.
[*] Improved Character Selection that provides much needed information about the characters.[/list]

[h1]Movement changes [/h1]
[list][*] Sprinting now Un-crouches you if crouched
[*] Added toggle sprint option in option in game menu
[*] All characters have had their movement speed reduced across the board to make the game feel more realistic. 
[*] Added a slight bit of weight to the game movement with Directional movement speed differences - Each direction has its own speed values for standing and crouch. 
[*] Example moving side to side will be slower than moving forward.[/list]

[h1]Revised footstep sounds to insensitive more stealth play. [/h1]
[list][*] All running footstep sounds have had their volume increased
[*] All walking and crouching footstep sounds have had their volumes decrease.[/list]

[h1]Jump upgrade [/h1]
[list][*] Jumping while crouch has different jumping stats than if jumping while standing.
[*] Jumping standing and crouching have different stamina costs.[/list]

[h1]Inventory[/h1]
[list][*] Picking up items automatically goes into a free inventory slot
[*] Picking up ammo without having a gun in your inventory will save the ammo and add it to your gun ammo if you do pick up a gun later
[*] Mouse Scroll wheel - Scroll through inventory with mouse wheel.[/list]

[h1]New music composed by Spectral Fields[/h1]
[list][*] Punkie Theme Music	
[*] Werewolf - Theme Music (beta not finished)[/list]

[h1]New Audio Logic[/h1] 
All Legends now have theme music that will play once there is 1 min left on the glyph timer. In future updates coming soon the Legend theme music will play when you play as the legend and when the legend freezes the Glyph timer. 

[h1]Weapon Functionality [/h1]
[list][*] Crosshair for Throwing weapons. 
[*] You can now shoot through and attack through the barbed wire fence on Punkie's Farmhouse map.[/list]

[h1]Scoreboard Update[/h1]
Cast Objectives
	Legend Objectives
	Player Rank
	Show Character Icons - [i]Legends have the same Icon to preserve the suspense.[/i]
	Your FATE score (replacing is replacing XP)
	Your Ping
	Pregame has different objects displayed.

[h1]End Game Screen [/h1]
[list][*] Now showcases the cast player that killed the legend
[*] Player that accumulated the most FP/Xp, 
[*] Player who found the Glyph 
[*] Showcase Legend - If he wins the game/ Kills everyone[/list]

[h1]You can now access the options menu in the Character select and Ready screens[/h1]

[h1]Regenerating Health Displays HP on player HUD[/h1]

[h1]Viewing the comic now scrolls faster with mouse wheel.[/h1]

[h1]Steam Cloud support.[/h1] [i]Everything should work although it hasn’t been thoroughly tested yet. Be aware that the progression may still have a few bugs in it. [/i]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] FIXED - Gourd AI Spit can now hit you if you are crouched.
[*] FIXED - Charged Melee Attack Bug. 
[*] FIXED - AI Projectiles cause a hitmarker for other legends in pregame.
[/list]

[h1]KNOWN BUGS/ISSUES[/h1] 

[b]Character Select Bug:[/b] Sometimes randomly a match will start without letting you choose your character, Legend will default be Punkie, and all cast will be Stevie. We are still working on fixing this issue. Hotfix coming very soon.

[b]Doors are effected by lag.[/b] If you are playing with someone with a very high ping doors may act a little strange. We are currently looking into fixing this for later updates. 

[b]AI can be unresponsive.[/b] There are still a few kinks to work out with the AI. Ravers sometimes dont run away when you attack them. Fix coming soon.

[h1]Werewolf Game Guide Coming Soon![/h1]
We didn't have time to create a Werewolf Game Guide, but don't worry its in the works and should be out soon!

[h1]New Map delayed.[/h1]
I'm sorry to announce this but, the new progression system was a lot more work then we initially anticipated. Which means that the new map has been pushed back for a week or two. More info on this coming soon. Hopefully there is enough here to keep you occupied while you wait for the new map. Thank you for your patience! 

Have a Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Update 0.2.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Net-code rework. [/h1]
We just finished a massive update to the game's net-code, improving stability when playing with other players from other countries. It also improves how the game handles AI like Gourd, Cops, and the Harbinger.

[h1]New Cast Member![/h1]
[b]Security Shawn.[/b]
Armed with a Stun Gun. Security Shawn is great for stopping a Legend in his tracks mid chase. In-force those curfews people!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/9855ebca3779306e045e063fbd47117ea6cea768.gif[/img]
[i]Stats
Health: 2/5
Stamina: 3/5
Speed:  4/5
Stealth:3/5
Agility: 4/5 
[/i]

[h1]New Items [/h1]
[b]Stun Gun.[/b]
This medium range non-lethal pistol is perfect for zapping away a Legend’s stamina to make a quick escape! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/abb0c4731574bbb066ca1afa996ead9f9e602bbe.gif[/img]

[b]Machete.[/b]
A sharp bladed weapon that can cut through Gourds like butter. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/38539e8daed17e9348564ffd73fe6bdeb1a0bb3e.gif[/img]

[h1]Map Updates.[/h1]
[b]Dream Realm: [/b]
[list]
[*] Now has less dead ends and more breaching paths. 
[*] Added rafters to the platforming room.
[/list]

[b]Farmhouse: [/b]
[list][*] Improved Punkie Jack-O-Lantern spawns. 
[*] More random Ammo spawns. 
[*] Updated Navmesh so AI's don't walk through Hay bales.
[/list]

[b]Cabin:[/b]
[list][*] A slightly increased the ambient light. 
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes.[/h1]
[b]Characters[/b]
[list][*] Angela Crass's crouch movement speed has been moderately increased..
[*] Angela Crass's walking footstep volume have been moderately lowered.
[*] Stevie Lint's run speed has been slightly reduced.
[*] Punkie's Crouch Speed has been increased.
[*] Killer Keith's HP has been increased by 50 points. 
[*] Killer Keith's Walk speed has been slightly reduced.
[*] Killer Keith's Toxic Chemicals now do more damage and now last a lot longer.
[*] Killer Keith's Rebar now goes farther and does more damage.
[*] Killer Keith's Rebar draw speed had been lowered.
[*] Killer Keith's Rebar reload speed has been drastically increased.
[*] Human Punkie’s Regen now regens 50 Stamina with an additional 10 HP for 5 seconds.
[*] Human Punkie’s Regen charges have been reduced to 20 from 30. 
[*] Legend’s Nightvision’s range has been drastically reduced.
[/list]

Items
[list][*] Shotgun's max clip size has been reduced to 4.
[*] Beer now slowly reduces stamina for 7 seconds after you drink it. 
[/list]

Objectives
[list][*] Glyph Sound radius has been reduced by 50%.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list][*] Nick Scab's reveal outline now outlines his entire body.
[*] Objective sounds should no longer play when game loads.
[*] Consumable items like Beer and Candy  can no longer be dropped when they are empty.
[*] Auto Respawn is no longer interrupted by chat.
[*] Fixed Melee weapon charging animation bug.
[*] Night Vision will no longer turn on when using chat. 
[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]New Map - Dream Realm[/h1]
Enter the surreal mindscape of a madman and survive your worst nightmare. Featuring a brand new score from [i]Spectral Fields[/i].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/f37601373b54b171e59b1c86ed1dbca70939ad17.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/87386770ef2cb3e6ea0d9b7c04f9a5c7942b0908.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/cec6fd575be69c8dc44219f0bf715e4edc85a2a0.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/b4f12902a349712cd796cc9fe7cad6a505a15e67.jpg[/img]


[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Specter Players will now be shown as [i]Dead[/i] in the Tab Screen.
[*] Beer will now drop empty cans every time you use them.
[*] Auto-Ready timer as been added.
[*] Specters can now shoot and kill each other. [b]Ghost Deathmatch![/b]
[*] AI Gourds will now follow the Gourd Legend. Lead them to those pesky Cast Members.  
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Punkie’s ranged attack now does poison damage (damage over time) and has a fancy cross hair when you zoom in.
[*] Candy - CryptiCoCo's will now heal 1 HP for 10 seconds.
[*] Increased Killer Keith's Chemicals's area of effect size and it also will reveal Cast players when they enter it.
[*] Flashlights now have a wider light radius. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Full Screen Bug: The game will no longer go to windowed mode when you start a new match.
[*] Aim Sensitivity Bug: Now your aim sensitivity will correctly apply to all weapons types.
[*] Specters will now die if they go out of bounds. 
[*] Fixed numerous areas where players were getting stuck while crouched.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/5e1c4565470482dd27cc1b2fc88a8fc03cb9d278.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/2a1c6ebef36868f332904af6a93b51a06558910d.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Legend: Killer Keith[/h1]

A slow but powerful Legend that leverages stealth to close in on his victims. Killer Keith has rapid health regeneration, so you’ll need to call the cops or gang up if you want to kill him. One on One fights are suicide. Although slow, Killer Keith doesn’t use stamina while power walking. However the Cast can still exhaust him with stamina damage to slow him down to base walking speed. 

[b]Abilities[/b]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/fb7c1b99f3f80cd0c33d7222c2484d4365f26a4c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/164bf9fbf8f727fe6da01668ae986883a81a66db.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/187e7b39c77448ca5bd3aa177a66b2ae352d3e67.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/eb376c4c71e6cae014385015425b731ea778e88c.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/a0d13f2e9506314921852363496db5523e9a11a6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/6da47d8e5d38292fc29c76c8bf1e08b8b1f248e1.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] [u]Combat Knife: [/u]Primary Attack is pretty basic, but a fully charged Secondary Attack will not only severely damage a Cast Member, but reveal them for a substantial amount of time. 
[*] [u]Rebar:[/u] If you have trouble closing in you can throw a very large piece of Rebar at fleeing Cast Members.
[*] [u]Chemicals:[/u] Create gas clouds in the map that drain Cast health and Stamina if they enter. Great for creating choke points. 
[/list]

[b]Specters and Killer Keith’s Post Game:[/b] If you are killed by Killer Keith you will become a ghostly Specter. While you can no longer interact with living players you can shorten the game’s timer by activating randomly spawned spirit energy. Doing so will help the Cast chances to escape and give you a generous XP boost. You can also haunt the map by destroying lights, windows, and opening and closing doors. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/6a3b7ed9a95fd3e36cb3e4379fe70d5be5f19934.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/c1510486740efdca2eae1a8bdcecdf6c7b3e3890.png[/img][/url]


[h1]New Objective[/h1]

[b]Call the Cops.[/b] You can now call the cops if you find a randomly spawned radio in the map. The radio is attached to a dead police office most likely an early victim of the Legend. Make the call and AI Cops will enter the map to help you face the Legend. If the Legend takes damage from the Cops, it will be revealed to the Cast for a short amount of time. This is your chance to attack if you are trying to kill it. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/9af177024f9bdafde6854f3312268542d88bedd5.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/a93bb0d1e53a591016dff8eec1095bc85246329d.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Cast Updates[/h1]

[b]Inventory:[/b] The Cast now have various inventory slots available to them depending on which one you are playing as. For example Stevie Lint has 4 inventory slots available to him while Ryan only has two. You can see your inventory on the bottom of the screen. Use the number keys to switch between them. This also applies to Legend abilities as well. 


[b]Consumables: [/b]Candy and Beer will now be removed from your inventory when you run out of charges.

[b]Third-person: [/b]Cast are now able to use a third person camera! Great for peeking around corners...

[h1]New NPCs[/h1]

[b]Black Cat:[/b] Watch your step, you may cross paths with a black cat. If you do it hiss at you revealing you to the Legend for a short amount of time. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/05cf8ef461a8c7c0893dcbc8fb1acdd9ce466fdd.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/2f26ffdb9f7e39d4b490dee1a0c3ebd6c95f9fce.png[/img][/url]

[b]Harbinger: [/b] A stranger wanders the maps of Horror Legends. If he finds you he may give you a consumable item after warning you of the horrors that await you. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/d4cf8b838444232a554a0d3f7cf769044809ebab.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/97923b9ce7f08c231d31009bf627951ebfffccd6.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Cops:[/b] If called, these boys in blue will report to the closest Cast member and act as a bodyguard. Again, if they successfully attack the Legend it will be revealed to you for a short amount of time.
 

[h1]Mechanics / Features[/h1]

[b]3D Voice Chat:[/b] Voice chat now works in Horror Legends. However you can only hear who ever is nearby. Great for eavesdropping!

[b]Reveal Icon: [/b]This will appear accompanied right above your health to let you know that you can be seen by the other team. If you see this don’t try to hide, RUN!  (Note: AI Gourd are drawn to Revealed players.) 

[b]Stamina Update:[/b] Exhausting Stamina will now trigger a taunt for the Cast. Legend Exhaust sounds are more noticeable. Listen for the queues so you know when its time to run away! 

[b]Nightvision: [/b]Legends can now see in the dark by pressing V. Each Legends have different strengths of Night Vision for balance. Happy hunting.

[h1]Map Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] All Vegetation have improved graphics and performance.
[*] Maps have new lighting to improve the atmosphere and spook factor. Use your Flashlights and Night Vision!
[*] New creepy background music for the Cabin by Spectral Fields. 
[*] Drastically increased item spawns.
[*] Hedge Maze map starts with the lights off.
[*] Improved Cabin’s fireplace particle effects and lighting.
[*] Improved Glyph spawn points. 
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved Punkie Animations
[*] Improved Glyph graphics
[*] Replaced Gourd attack sounds. 
[*] Decreased everyone’s running speed slightly. 
[*] Replaced Door sound effects. 
[*] Replaced Shotgun sound.
[*] Replaced Punch sound.
[*] Decreased Pistol damage slightly.
[*] The Shotgun and Revolver do mild stamina damage.
[*] Replaced blood impact effects.
[*] Increased Gourd Stamina regeneration rate.
[/list]



[i]After this update we plan of focusing more on content rather than features. So expect more maps, items, and characters in the next month or so. I planned to create a Game Guide for all the new features but ran out of time. For now, I hope these patch notes will suffice until I can make a proper in game guide. However it is now time for me to prepare for my wedding and pack from my honeymoon! Before I go I just want to say thanks again for all your support. Without it updates like this wouldn't be possible. Have fun killing each other I’ll see you all in a week![/i]

[i]Drake: Lead Game Designer. [/i]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/b0c71f06b3470a4181776631f5b8b9a2d49891c7.png[/img]
[i]Version 0.2.1 Update![/i]

[h1]Game Logic Rework[/h1]

The game logic has been completely redone which means no more random Legend selecting, getting a head start on the Legend before selected, and map voting. Instead we have the following.

[b]PreGame (Before Player limit is reached)[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now fight AI Gourds while waiting for players to join. AI Gourds reward the player with 50 XP if killed.
[/list]
[b]Legend Queue[/b]
[list]
[*] Once the required Player limit has been met the game will load the Legend Queue.
[*] The Legend Queue will select a Legend based on the order the players joined the server. 
[*] Players can pass their turn as the Legend during the Legend Queue if the want.
[*] Once the Legend has been picked Legend Player chooses the map.
[/list]
[b]Main Game[/b]
[list]
[*] Both Cast and Legend have a Character Select Screen.
[*] Game won't start until all players are ready.
[/list]
[b]EndGame[/b]
[*] Once the Main Game is over the game load the Legend Queue again and next Player in line becomes the Legend and chooses the map. They can pass their turn if they want.
[/list]

[h1]Cast Objective[/h1]
[b]Escape Sigil[/b]
[list]
[*] Find randomly spawned Glyph in the Map that starts the timer.
[*] Cast now have to survive the duration of the timer.
[*] When the Timer runs out a random Sigil will spawn and be revealed to the Cast.
[*] All remaining Cast are revealed to the legend.
[*] All remaining Cast must enter the Sigil to escape
[/list].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/6688244ebf8aecbaa9d3bacb6df4b981ce95e1e3.gif[/img]


[h1]Main Menu overhaul[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improvements to menus and UI
[/list]

[h1]Tracking[/h1]
[b]Tracking Gourds[/b]
[list]
[*] Punkie can now spawn AI Gourds from his Jack o lanterns that slowly lead you to hiding cast members.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/3c606b33f00d8943f5dbb0244576d1b2ffffb578.gif[/img]
[b]Sense[/b]
[list]
[*] William Punkie, Gourds, and Ryan Steele now have the Sense ability that lets the player know if an enemy is nearby 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/e526308a8407dc87fe2cef63ee740c5335eb7ca6.gif[/img]

[h1]Game Guide[/h1]
[list]
[*] The main menu now has a Game Guide that goes over some of the game’s need to know mechanics.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33852864/1e7a9494849f1112a71a263cdcdddc6c079ebaed.jpg[/img]
[h1]Added Inverted Y axis support.[/h1]

[h1]Map changes.[/h1]
Revised Hedge Maze Map and Cabin

Sheriff John Russell has been the local town Sheriff of Hudson Meadows for the past 20 years. He is known as one of the men that shot and “killed” William Punkie, ending his killing spree on Halloween night 12 years ago. He is an honorable family man, a good cop, and loved by the community.

Speed:  2/5
Stealth: 5/5
Agility: 1/5

Killing a Cast member will force them to become your Gourd minion.
